ProgramUnit.Name: CREATE_FIXED_DRIVES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE create_fixed_drives (start_date in date,end_date in date,parm_site_id in varchar2,parm_chapter_id in varchar2) IS
 v_site_id varchar2(10) ;
 curdate date ;
 insert_spon_id varchar2(10) ;
 default_recruiter_id varchar2(10) ;
 cur_week_day varchar2(3) ;
 cur_frequency varchar2(1) ;
 weeks_in_month number(2) ;
 v_projected_draw number:=0;
 drive_start_time_char varchar2(13);
 drive_end_time_char varchar2(13) ;
 drive_start_time date;
 drive_end_time date ;
 v_don_type varchar2(5);
 new_id varchar2(10) ;
 err_flag varchar2(1) ;
 err_msg varchar2(100) ;
 site_goal number ;
 selection varchar2(1) ;
 freq_flag varchar2(3) ;
 v_proc_code varchar2(5) ;
 number_of_drives number := 0 ;
 err_return exception ;
 default_proj_deferral number ;
 l_territory_id varchar2(10); ----- Added by MG 6/99
 t_count number;
 t_chapter_id chapters.chapter_id%type;
 i_tz CHAR(1):= 'N';

 cursor c1 is 
 select site_id, locations.location_name location_name, location_type
 from fixed_sites, locations
 where fixed_sites.site_id = decode(parm_site_id,'ALL',fixed_sites.site_id,parm_site_id)
 and fixed_sites.chapter_id = parm_chapter_id 
 and locations.location_id = fixed_sites.site_id
 and locations.chapter_id = parm_chapter_id ;

 cursor c2 is 
 select proc_code
 from fixed_site_hours
 where site_id = v_site_id
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and week_day = cur_week_day
 and ( (freq_flag = 'ALL' and frequency_code = '0') 
 or frequency_code = cur_frequency) ;

 cursor get_parm_val_cur(p_chapter_id in varchar2) is -- Added chapter_id parameter. Added by Kishore on 02/04/2011. IM 4697
 select parameter_value 
 from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'FIXDEFRT' 
 -- and chapter_id = p_chapter_id; --IM 5652 Below line added to ensure checking for ALL in case of multichapter env
 and chapter_id = DECODE(i_tz,'Y','ALL', p_chapter_id);
BEGIN
 curdate := start_date ;
 insert_spon_id := :control_block.s_spon_id ;
 
 /* IM5652 Added to handle multichapter env related issues */
 IF is_multi_chapter
 THEN
 i_tz := 'Y';
 ELSE
 i_tz := 'N';
 END IF;
 
 /* IM 5652 End*/

 -- Added by Kishore on 02/04/2011. IM 4697
 begin
 select count(*)
 into t_count
 from institution_tables
 where upper(table_name) = 'VALID_PARAMETERS';
 end;
 
 if t_count > 0 then
 t_chapter_id := 'ALL';
 else
 t_chapter_id := :global.chapter_id;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 for get_parm_val_rec in get_parm_val_cur(t_chapter_id) loop
 default_proj_deferral := get_parm_val_rec.parameter_value ;
 end loop ;

/*------------------------
 begin
 select parameter_value 
 into default_spon_id
 from valid_parameters
 where chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and parameter_code='SPFIX' ;
 exception
 when others then
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 0') ;
 raise ;
 end ;
---------------------------*/

/* Pick user entered Recruiter first. If not entered, use default recruiter */
 if :control_block.s_recruiter_id is null then
 begin
 select parameter_value 
 into default_recruiter_id
 from valid_parameters
 where chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and parameter_code = 'RECFIX' ;

 exception
 when others then
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 0.1') ;
 raise ;
 end ;
 else 
 default_recruiter_id := :control_block.s_recruiter_id ;
 end if ;

------------ Following added by MG 6/99 to get territory_id for recruiter -----
 begin
 select territory_id into l_territory_id
 from territory_assignments
 where recruiter_id = default_recruiter_id
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+2)
 and rownum < 2;
 exception
 when no_data_found then l_territory_id := null;
 end;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 while curdate <= end_date loop
/* If curdate falls on the day which is not selected for drive creation in control block,
 then do not do processing for this date */
 if substr(to_char(curdate,'DAY'),1,3) = 'SUN' then
 if :control_block.s_sun = 'N' then
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 end if ;

 elsif substr(to_char(curdate,'DAY'),1,3) = 'MON' then
 if :control_block.s_mon = 'N' then
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 end if ;

 elsif substr(to_char(curdate,'DAY'),1,3) = 'TUE' then
 if :control_block.s_tue = 'N' then
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 end if ;

 elsif substr(to_char(curdate,'DAY'),1,3) = 'WED' then
 if :control_block.s_wed = 'N' then
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 end if ;

 elsif substr(to_char(curdate,'DAY'),1,3) = 'THU' then
 if :control_block.s_thu = 'N' then
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 end if ;

 elsif substr(to_char(curdate,'DAY'),1,3) = 'FRI' then
 if :control_block.s_fri = 'N' then
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 end if ;

 elsif substr(to_char(curdate,'DAY'),1,3) = 'SAT' then
 if :control_block.s_sat = 'N' then
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 end if ;

 else
 null ;
 end if ;

 for c1rec in c1 loop
 begin
 select 'x' 
 into selection
 from drives
 where drive_date = curdate
 and location_id = c1rec.site_id
 and drive_type = 'F'
 and status != 'CANCL'
 and rownum = 1 ;
 goto next_date_iter ; 
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then 
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 0.5') ;
 raise ;
 end ;

 cur_week_day := to_char(curdate,'DY') ;
 cur_frequency := to_char(curdate,'W') ;
 weeks_in_month := to_char(last_day(curdate),'D') ;


 -- If this date is in the last week of the month, 
 -- then change value of cur_frequency to 'L' .

 if weeks_in_month = 4 and cur_frequency = '4' then 
 cur_frequency := 'L' ;
 elsif weeks_in_month = 5 and cur_frequency = '5' then 
 cur_frequency := 'L' ;
 end if ;

 BEGIN
 --message(to_char(curdate,'DY')||' Fre='||cur_frequency);pause;
 select 'x' into selection
 from fixed_site_hours where site_id = c1rec.site_id
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and week_day = cur_week_day
 and frequency_code = cur_frequency and rownum = 1; --The rownum=1 was added for the PR# 001.040081

 Begin
 select to_date(to_char(curdate,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||
 --to_char(min(slot_time),'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),
 min(to_char(slot_time,'HH24:MI')),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),
 to_date(to_char(curdate,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||
 --to_char(max(slot_time),'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')
 max(to_char(slot_time,'HH24:MI')),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')
 into drive_start_time, drive_end_time
 from fixed_site_hours
 where site_id = c1rec.site_id
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and week_day = cur_week_day
 and frequency_code = cur_frequency ;
 Exception
 when others then 
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 1') ;
 raise ;
 End ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found then 
 Begin
 select 'x' into selection from fixed_site_hours
 where site_id = c1rec.site_id 
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and week_day = cur_week_day 
 and frequency_code = '0' 
 and rownum = 1; 
 
 Begin
 select to_date(to_char(curdate,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||
 --to_char(min(slot_time),'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),
 min(to_char(slot_time,'HH24:MI')),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),
 to_date(to_char(curdate,'MM-DD-RR')||' '||
 --to_char(max(slot_time),'HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')
 max(to_char(slot_time,'HH24:MI')),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI')
 into drive_start_time,drive_end_time
 from fixed_site_hours
 where site_id = c1rec.site_id
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and week_day = cur_week_day
 and frequency_code = '0' ;
 Exception
 when others then
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 1.5') ;
 raise ;
 End ;
 Exception
 when no_data_found then -- Site is closed
 exit ;
 when others then
 set_application_property(CURSOR_STYLE, 'DEFAULT');
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 2') ;
 raise ;
 End ;
 WHEN others then
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 3') ;
 raise ;
 END;
 
 begin
 select nvl(sum(goal_count),0) 
 into site_goal
 from goals
 where goal_type = 'STGOL'
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and goal_start_date = curdate
 and goal_end_date = curdate
 and goal_custodian = c1rec.site_id ;
 end ;

 don_common_pack.generate_new_id('DRV',new_id,err_flag,err_msg) ;
 if err_flag = 'Y' then
 message('Error 4 '||err_msg) ;
 raise err_return ;
 end if ;

 begin
 insert into drives
 (chapter_id,
 drive_id,
 drive_date,
 schedule_start_time,
 drive_type,
 status,
 drive_category,
 location_id,
 recruiter_id,
 schedule_end_time,
 territory_id, ---- Added by MG 6/99
 program_id)
 values
 (parm_chapter_id,
 new_id,
 curdate,
 LIFETRACK_TIMEZONE_CONVERT.GET_GMT_TIME(parm_chapter_id, drive_start_time), --drive_start_time, -- V07 - SCR 19253
 'F',
 'CNFRM',
 'GENL',
 c1rec.site_id,
 default_recruiter_id,
 LIFETRACK_TIMEZONE_CONVERT.GET_GMT_TIME(parm_chapter_id, drive_end_time), --drive_end_time, -- V07 - SCR 19253
 l_territory_id, ---- Added by MG 6/99
 'MCICRTFX') ;
 exception
 when others then
 message('Error 5 '||sqlerrm) ;
 raise ;
 end ;
 begin
 insert into drive_sponsors
 (drive_id,
 sponsor_id,
 chapter_id,
 proj_deferral_rate,
 projected_show ,
 projected_draw,
 program_id)
 values
 (new_id,
 insert_spon_id,
 parm_chapter_id,
 default_proj_deferral,
 ( site_goal * 100 ) / ( 100 - default_proj_deferral), 
 site_goal,
 'MCICRTFX' ) ;

 number_of_drives := number_of_drives + 1 ;
 :rec_no := number_of_drives ;
 if :display_drives.drive_id is not null then
 next_record ;
 end if ;
 :display_drives.drive_id := new_id ;
 :display_drives.drive_date := curdate ;
 :display_drives.site_name := c1rec.location_name ;
 --pitss synchronize ;

 exception
 when others then
 message('Error 6 '||sqlerrm) ;
 raise ;
 end ;

 v_site_id := c1rec.site_id ;
 freq_flag := 'N' ;
 begin
 select 'ALL'
 into freq_flag
 from fixed_site_hours
 where site_id = v_site_id
 and chapter_id = parm_chapter_id
 and week_day = cur_week_day
 and frequency_code = cur_frequency
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then
 message(to_char(sqlcode)||' '||sqlerrm||' :Error 6.2') ;
 raise ;
 end ;
 
 --Insert into drive_procedures table got removed as it never worked before -refer 2.03 projet for reference 
 
 End loop ; -- End of c1 for loop
<<next_date_iter>>
 curdate := curdate + 1 ;
 end loop ; -- End of while curdate loop
exception
 when err_return then raise ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: TIME_FORMAT_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE time_format_function (input_str in varchar2,output_str out varchar2) IS
 string_length number ;
 formatted_str varchar2(5) ;
BEGIN
/*-- This procedure formats time in HH24:MI format ---*/ 

string_length := NVL(length(input_str), 0) ;

if string_length > 5 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
elsif string_length = 5 then
 if substr(input_str,3,1) = ':' then

 if to_number(substr(input_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(input_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 output_str := input_str ;
 end if ;
 else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
elsif string_length = 4 then
 output_str := substr(input_str,1,2) ||':'||substr(input_str,3,2) ;
 if to_number(substr(output_str,1,2)) > 23 or to_number(substr(output_str,4,2)) > 59 then
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

else
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
end if ;
exception
 when value_error then 
 show_error('11110') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then
 handle_error ;
 check_package_failure ;

END;
